input.body: Hello, this is Donna from the lettings agency about 22 Marlow Street, Dunmere (ref R/3). Sorry this has come back. I can't find the earlier repair in our records, so please could you tell me: what the problem is and where in the property, roughly when it happened before and who came to fix it (us, the landlord or someone else). A photo would help if you can send one. If it involves water you can't stop, a gas smell, sparking or burning smells, or a door or window that won't lock, please call us straight away instead of waiting for a reply, and for gas call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999. I'll check back with you tomorrow if I haven't heard from you.

I texted the tenant asking what the problem is, where it is, when it happened before and who fixed it, and asked for a photo. The same text gave emergency advice in case it turns out to be urgent. The ticket is on hold until tomorrow, when I'll chase the tenant if they haven't replied.
